name: Pro Counter Left
purpose: Show them the toss to the tight end side, then hand it the other way to the fullback behind a pulling guard.

X.rule: Block the defender covering you. He is the one who can make this tackle.

LT.rule: Block down on the first defender inside you.

LG.rule: Block down on the first defender inside you.

C.rule: Block the nose. Do not let him cross your face.

RG.rule: PULL LEFT. Stay flat and kick out the first defender outside our tackle.

RT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you. Nobody crosses your face.

TE.rule: Block back and cut off pursuit. You are the last one to the ball.

Z.rule: Come across behind the line and cut off anybody chasing from the backside.

QB.rule: Fake the toss to the halfback going right, then turn back and hand to the fullback. Sell the fake first.

FB.rule: Take one step toward the fake, then plant and run behind the pulling guard.

HB.rule: Run the full toss path at full speed with your arms tucked. You are the decoy.

coaching_points: Run the toss two or three times first. This play only exists because of that one.
The fullback's first step is toward the fake. If he leans the wrong way early, their linebacker never moves.
